title: EventEnvelope
description: Shared envelope for Evidara domain events. Uses a small CloudEvents-aligned metadata set with a JSON payload.

event_type.description: Stable logical event name. Event names are versionless; breaking changes use a higher event_version.

event_version.description: Major version of the event contract.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation ID spanning multiple events and commands in the same workflow.

causation_id.description: Optional event or command ID that directly caused this event.
